facts.fact: 压低帽重回利兹，最怕撞见 Gloria。
facts.anchor: He wasn’t exactly trying to go incognito. This was no spy movie, and it was beneath Dr Aiden Berkeley to stoop to a full disguise. But he was anxious not to attract recognition when he stepped onto the platform at Leeds railway station. He kept his head down, covered by a navy blue beanie hat, just in case. It didn’t suit him but that didn’t matter right now. Leeds may be a big city, but still it was all too easy to run into someone you knew. Or someone you used to know. Aiden was anxious to avoid any awkward encounters. Most of all, he hoped he would not see Gloria. There was no convincing way to explain his presence here. She had seen through his lies in their marriage and he didn’t doubt she was capable of still seeing through him now, twenty years down the line.
She could smell bullshit from two hundred yards away.

facts.fact: 一封"那女孩的邮件"让 Emily 重新有了动静。
facts.anchor: The girl’s email had come as a shock. All those years of hearing nothing about Emily, not a single mention by anyone, no more newspaper articles, no more shameless reporters trying to dig things up. And then, suddenly, this. It reawakened something in him, how could it not?

facts.fact: 他的自我开脱：她成年、是她先开始。
facts.anchor: Emily had been nineteen years old, a fully consenting adult. And most importantly, she had started it.
